home.heroDesc: From a single document, {brand} extracts reality seeds to auto-generate a parallel world with up to {agentScale}. Inject variables from a god's-eye view to find the {optimalSolution} in complex group dynamics.
home.slogan: Let Agents rehearse the future, let decisions prevail
home.systemReadyDesc: Prediction engine on standby. Upload unstructured data to initialize a simulation sequence.
home.step01Desc: Seed extraction & memory injection & GraphRAG construction
home.step02Desc: Entity extraction & persona generation & Agent config injection
home.step03Desc: Dual-platform parallel sim & auto-parse requirements & temporal memory
home.step04Desc: ReportAgent interacts with the post-simulation environment via rich tools
home.step05Desc: Chat with any simulated individual & converse with ReportAgent
home.promptPlaceholder: // Describe your simulation or prediction requirement in natural language
home.consumerPromptPlaceholder: // Optional: add extra instructions for the consumer propagation test. If left blank, MiroConsumer will use the default concept/copy test prompt.
home.consumerDefaultPrompt: Run a consumer propagation test on the uploaded concept and copy materials. Simulate first impressions, discussion spread, resonance, objections, and misread risks among the target audience.
home.consumerBriefHint: Required for concept and copy testing in consumer mode.
home.consumerConceptPlaceholder: Describe the product concept or paste one concept per line.
home.consumerCopyPlaceholder: Paste the copy lines to test, one line per row.
home.consumerClaimsPlaceholder: Optional. Separate by comma or newline.
home.consumerPackagingAssetsPlaceholder: Describe packaging cues, claims, or asset labels—one per line.
home.consumerTestVariantsPlaceholder: Enter at least 2 variants, one per line. Each line becomes a variant label.
home.consumerPricePointsPlaceholder: Enter price options or ranges, separated by comma or newline.
home.consumerPriceContextPlaceholder: Optional framing text: subscription, promo, single pack, etc.
home.consumerAudiencePlaceholder: Required. Example: working moms, fitness beginners.
home.consumerScenePlaceholder: Optional. Example: weekday breakfast, commute snack.
home.consumerResearchGoalPlaceholder: Required. What do you want to learn from the propagation test?
home.consumerResearchModeHint: Auto Enrich runs automatic pre-research to enrich the simulation with category context and risk signals.
home.consumerEnableLaneBHint: Enable public-web supplemental research to fill gaps with external sources.
home.consumerBackgroundMaterialsPlaceholder: Optional. Paste any background research, competitor signals, or known risk points—one per line.

step1.ontologyDesc: LLM analyzes document content and simulation requirements, extracts reality seeds, and auto-generates a suitable ontology structure
step1.graphRagDesc: Based on the generated ontology, documents are auto-chunked and sent to Zep to build a knowledge graph, extracting entities and relations, forming temporal memory and community summaries
step1.buildCompleteDesc: Graph build is complete. Proceed to the next step for simulation environment setup.

step2.simInstanceDesc: Create a new simulation instance and pull world parameter templates
step2.generateAgentPersonaDesc: Combine context to auto-extract entities and relations from the knowledge graph, initialize simulated individuals, and assign unique behaviors and memories based on reality seeds
step2.dualPlatformConfigDesc: LLM intelligently sets world time flow, recommendation algorithms, each individual's active hours, posting frequency, event triggers, and more based on requirements and reality seeds
step2.initialActivationDesc: Auto-generate initial activation events and hot topics based on narrative direction to guide the simulation world's initial state
step2.setupCompleteDesc: Simulation environment is ready. You can now start the simulation.
step2.roundsConfigDesc: MiroConsumer auto-plans to simulate {hours} real-world hours, each round representing {minutesPerRound} minutes of elapsed time
step2.customTip: For first-time runs, we strongly recommend switching to 'Custom Mode' to reduce rounds for a quick preview and lower error risk
step2.personaDimExperienceDesc: Complete behavioral trajectory in this event

step3.oldSimCleared: Old simulation logs cleared, restarting simulation
step3.preparingGoBack: Preparing to return to Step 2, closing simulation...
step3.closeFailed: Failed to close simulation environment, attempting force stop...

step4.panelKeyFacts: Latest key facts from temporal memory

step5.chatWithAgent: Chat with any individual in the world
step5.reportAgentDesc: A conversational version of the report generation agent with access to 4 professional tools and MiroConsumer's complete memory
step5.toolInsightForgeDesc: Aligns real-world seed data with simulation state, combining Global/Local Memory for cross-temporal deep attribution analysis
step5.toolPanoramaSearchDesc: Graph-based BFS algorithm that reconstructs event propagation paths, capturing the full topology of information flow
step5.toolQuickSearchDesc: GraphRAG-based instant query interface with optimized indexing for fast extraction of node attributes and discrete facts
step5.toolInterviewSubAgentDesc: Autonomous interviews that conduct parallel multi-round dialogues with simulated individuals, collecting unstructured opinion data and psychological states
step5.chatEmptyReportAgent: Chat with Report Agent to explore report content in depth
step5.chatEmptyAgent: Chat with simulated individuals to understand their perspectives
step5.surveyInputPlaceholder: Enter the question you want to ask all selected targets...
step5.selectAgentFirst: Please select a simulated individual first

quickPrompts.resonance: Why did "{point}" become a top resonance point?
quickPrompts.risk: Why did "{point}" get amplified during propagation?
quickPrompts.misread: How did "{point}" turn into a misread?
quickPrompts.sourceRisk: Which source triggered the risk signal about "{summary}"?
quickPrompts.sourceInfluence: Which sources influenced the spread of these signals?
quickPrompts.branchFork: How does the branch "{branchName}" (forked at round {forkRound}) differ from the base run?
quickPrompts.branchIntervention: What impact did the {count} intervention type(s) have on acceptance?
quickPrompts.crossCommunitySpread: Why did the signal spread across {count} cross-community events?
quickPrompts.blockageReason: What caused {count} blockage events during propagation?
quickPrompts.reversalPattern: What patterns explain the {count} reversal events?
quickPrompts.bridgeActivity: How did bridge personas influence spread in {count} events?
quickPrompts.amplifierActivity: Which messages were amplified most by high-reach personas?
quickPrompts.narrativeTakeover: How close did a single narrative come to dominating the conversation?
quickPrompts.comparisonBranchVsBase: How does the branch "{right}" differ from the base run "{left}"?
quickPrompts.comparisonRunVsRun: What explains the difference between run "{left}" and run "{right}"?
quickPrompts.comparisonProjectVsProject: How do the research findings differ between project "{left}" and project "{right}"?
quickPrompts.comparisonResonanceOverlap: What do the overlapping resonance signals tell us about the core message?
quickPrompts.comparisonRecurringRisks: Why do these risk signals keep appearing across both runs?
quickPrompts.comparisonDivergence: The signal "{signal}" diverges between runs. What explains this?
quickPrompts.comparisonAcceptanceDelta: Acceptance {direction} by {delta} percentage points. What drove this?
quickPrompts.lowConfidenceFindings: {count} finding(s) have low confidence. Which evidence should be strengthened?
quickPrompts.weakEvidence: {count} finding(s) rely on weak or insufficient evidence. What additional sources could improve support?
quickPrompts.replayCalibration: This report has not been benchmarked. Run a replay to calibrate confidence.
quickPrompts.packagingHook: Why did "{point}" become a top packaging hook?
quickPrompts.packagingTrust: Why did "{point}" trigger a trust/credibility objection?
quickPrompts.packagingConfusion: How did "{point}" cause confusion about the packaging?
quickPrompts.abWinningVariant: Why did variant "{variant}" outperform the others?
quickPrompts.abVariantDelta: What explains the resonance/risk delta between "{left}" and "{right}"?
quickPrompts.abPersonaDivergence: Why did personas diverge between "{variantA}" and "{variantB}"?
quickPrompts.priceAcceptable: Why is "{point}" perceived as an acceptable price point?
quickPrompts.priceObjection: How does "{point}" affect perceived value for money?
